rationale: The HN thread (115 upvotes, 63 comments) documents real daily friction for tech professionals whose primary news sources are now saturated with AI content. Willingness-to-pay is demonstrated by thriving paid comps (The Pragmatic Engineer ~20k+ paid subs at $14/mo, TLDR ~750k subscribers with sponsorship revenue, Axios Pro Tech at $599/yr), confirming this segment pays for curated information. The pain is real and frequent but severity is moderate rather than burning — no workflow breaks, it costs time and attention rather than money or compliance risk.
